desc:
📱 Start broke with just a phone on a messy desk. Go live, get viewers and stream your way to millions!

🎥 HOLD to stream and watch the viewers and cash pour in.
🎙️ Upgrade your camera, mic, lights and skills.
🏠 Grow your empire: house, car, pool, streaming house, merch shop and arena, all with an epic cut scene for every upgrade.
👥 Hire your crew to earn cash for you, even while you stream.
💼 Get enough live viewers and a rich investor offers you a deal that boosts your cash FOREVER.

⭐ FEATURES
• Hold to stream for viewers and cash
• Gear and skill upgrades
• Build your own plot from a tiny shack to a mega mansion
• Crew members who earn for you
• Investor deals (rebirth) for permanent boosts
• Offline earnings when you come back
• Teleport to every area of your plot

👍 Like the game and join the group for more updates!

From broke to viral. How famous can YOU get?
